ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description: Ask questions in Arabic, German, or English. Get answers grounded in real Syrian law — and clear admissions when the AI doesn't know.

trust.heading: We are honest about what is hard
trust.description: Buying property in Syria today is not simple. Records were falsified during the previous regime. Foreign ownership requires Interior Ministry approval. Banking is still being rebuilt. A specialized property court opens in 2026. We do not hide these realities — we help you navigate them.
